description: For a live listing with a payout wallet: returns a 24-hour link that can do one thing, launch this game's optional coin. Give it to the creator. They open it in a browser with that Solana wallet (on a phone it opens inside Phantom, Solflare or Backpack), press Launch and approve in the wallet; it costs them about 0.0085 SOL and they earn 40% of every trading fee. You cannot launch the coin yourself: it needs the creator wallet's signature. The link cannot change the listing, and a new link retires the old one.
name: coin_launch_link
title: Get a link the creator opens to launch the game's coin
